description:
YITAMOTOR floor mats are made with high-density TPE material, using advanced 3D laser technology, which not only provides a superb feel and extreme wear resistance but also offers a precise fit to your vehicle floor.
Fitment
fit for 2017-2020 Chrysler Pacifica (Not fit for 7-Passenger Bench Seating)
fit for 2021-2024 Chrysler Pacifica (Only fit for Touring)
fit for 2025-2026 Chrysler Pacifica (Only fit for Select)
fit for 2020-2026 Chrysler Voyager Models (Only fit for Stow N'Go Bucket Seats)
NOT for 7-Passenger 2nd Row Bench Seating.
Does not fit vehicles with vinyl flooring,only for carpet flooring.
Features
Custom Fit: These floor mats and cargo liner fit for 2017 2018 2019 2020 Chrysler Pacifica (Not fit for 7-Passenger Bench Seating), fit for 2021 2022 2023 2024 Chrysler Pacifica (Only fit for Touring), fit for 2025-2026 Chrysler Pacifica (Only fit for Select); fit for 2020-2026 Chrysler Voyager Models (Only fit for Stow N'Go Bucket Seats)
Built For Durability: YITAMOTOR floor liners & cargo mats are made from premium TPE material featuring high tensity for great comfort and wear-resistance while remaining flexible and user-friendly even in extreme cold or hot environments; Product contains no latex, cadmium, lead, or any harmful PVC
All Season Protection & Non-Slip: The floor mats are uniquely designed channels and raised edges that can effectively trap liquid, debris, snow, mud, and sand to keep your car and shoes clean; Built-in retainer clips firmly grip the mat and prevent slipping when wet
Easy To Clean: Simply shake the dirt out of the textured skid-resistant surface or spray down with a hose; No vacuuming or harsh chemicals needed for maintenance
Why Choose YITAMOTOR: Our floor mats are processed with advanced technology, rendering tailored protection and all-weather guard to your vehicle; Our excellent pre- and after-sales attitude are always available to ensure your purchase is hassle-free.
highlights: They securely attach to your vehicle using the original factory clasps, keeping the floor liners firmly in place and preventing unwanted shifting during daily driving.
The raised edges provide maximum vehicle coverage, Floor Liners accurately and completely line the vehicle carpet giving absolute interior protection.
Specially designed channels ensure the liner effectively contain the liquid to keep your vehicle and shoes clean, non-slip design for safe driving.
